name: Restaurant Bella Vista
tagline: Authentic Italian Cuisine in the Heart of Bern
description: Welcome to Restaurant Bella Vista, where traditional Italian flavors meet Swiss hospitality. Since 2015, we've been serving authentic pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and seasonal specialties using the finest ingredients from local Swiss suppliers and imported Italian delicacies. Our family-run restaurant offers a warm, welcoming atmosphere perfect for romantic dinners, family gatherings, and business lunches.
